management_steps.details: RUQ / epigastric pain, nausea, vomiting, low-grade fever. Guarding, positive Murphy's sign (inspiratory pause on RUQ palpation).
Aesthetic criteria: gallstones/sludge AND 1+ of: GB wall thickening > 4mm, GB distension (diameter > 4cm, length > 10cm), pericholecystic fluid, ultrasonographic Murphy sign.
Augmentin 1.2g IV stat, antiemetics, and appropriate analgesia. Refer urgently to surgery.
